text.tspan: Foreign aid given as grants and concessional loansDAC countries
Net official development assistance (ODA) in the form of grants and concessional loans. This data is expressed
in US dollars and adjusted for inflation.
Note: Net loans are negative when repayments on previous loans are higher than new loans. This data is expressed in constant 2024 US$.
